scope: Single development demonstration, free_heavier seed 4003. This is not a held-out evaluation.
instruction: Investigate the unfamiliar red object, determine whether it can be moved, and if possible move it to the blue target.
gate_rationale: Existing G1/Qwen development gates: 1 mm penetration, 6 mm localization; independent released-object placement and safety scoring.
comparison: One real Qwen episode and one deterministic paired baseline with the same G1 scene, sensors, tools, controller and safety gates. No classical fallback in the Qwen episode.
